$comment: This registry's own mpdecimal (a CMake build of libmpdec, for CPython 3.13's _decimal), kept over the default registry's autotools port. 4.0.1 since M4 of carbon-mobile-exp-v8-upgrade (2026-11-17: the version microsoft/vcpkg afa249f1 resolves), with the 4.0.0 port's two fixes in CMakeLists.txt unchanged (BUILD_LIBMPDEC for MSVC's dllimport, and only on MSVC because Apple and Android clang reject __declspec). Port-version 1 so its version string differs from the default registry's 4.0.1#0.
